status: Frozen before outcome evaluation; draft content, no educator review

matrix.bits: Foundation, place value, ordering; procedure, concept, application within each
matrix.responseModel: Known bit supplies independently recomputed key; unknown bit supplies 999999. No inferred learning, slip or guess probability.
matrix.groundTruth: All nine bits required; an observed error must surface a conflict for that skill/facet.
matrix.burden: Nine entry originals per state. Count unresolved facets and available fresh checks; practice inventory is three specimens per skill, insufficient for the approved ten-original task.

profileAssumptions.full: All facets known; correct responses throughout.
profileAssumptions.foundational-gap: Foundation concept unknown; other eight cells known.
profileAssumptions.constant-zero-guess: No facets known; always writes 0, even where it happens to be correct.
profileAssumptions.lucky-all-correct: No facets known; stipulate all entry guesses correct, delayed answers wrong. Logical possibility, no assigned probability.
profileAssumptions.known-memorization: No facets known; entry keys copied and familiarity truthfully recorded.
profileAssumptions.hidden-memorization: No facets known; entry keys copied but falsely look novel/unassisted; delayed answers wrong.
profileAssumptions.assisted: No facets known; all entry keys supplied with assistance recorded.
profileAssumptions.retry-only: No facets known; all correct observations are flagged retry.
profileAssumptions.stale: All facets known; correct evidence is 20 days old.
profileAssumptions.conflicting: Place procedure now unknown; add a later synthetic eligible procedure error to otherwise correct history.
profileAssumptions.delayed-forgetting: All facets known on day 1; place procedure forgotten on day 3.
profileAssumptions.single-slip: All facets known; one deterministic entry concept slip on E-V-C; later correct responses. This is one constructed noise event, not a measured error rate.

heldOut.use: Day-3 outcome observation only; never initial readiness, selection, repair or gate tuning.
heldOut.separation: IDs and authored task-family labels disjoint from entry and practice; independence is an unreviewed hypothesis.
heldOut.unsupported: H-F-C requires human semantic scoring. H-O-P and H-O-A are choices. H-V-C/H-V-A contain possible construct bypasses requiring review.
heldOut.invalidation: Any tuning on these results retires this evaluation claim. Author and reserve new independently reviewed families for a future evaluation.
